title: Command Injection via Web Parameter
code:
from flask import Flask, request
import os

app = Flask(__name__)

@app.route('/ping')
def ping():
    # Untrusted user parameter flows directly into system shell
    target = request.args.get('ip')
    os.system('ping -c 1 ' + target)
    return 'Ping dispatched'
description: Vulnerable endpoint where an HTTP request parameter enters via request.args.get and reaches the os.system() sink via dynamic string concatenation.

title: Safe Parameterized Subprocess Execution
code:
import subprocess
import shlex

def safe_ping(target_ip: str) -> None:
    # Verified remediation: array argument vector without shell=True
    clean_ip = shlex.quote(target_ip)
    cmd = ['ping', '-c', '1', clean_ip]
    subprocess.run(cmd, check=True)
description: Remediated safe implementation using subprocess.run with argument vector and shlex sanitization, immune to shell command injection.
